title: KP editor visible animation player v0 loop

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Closeout recommends mounting selected equation and graph runtime-frame consumers.
Roadmap names visible editor animation runtime mounting as the active focus.

allowedWork: Only implement the approved visible editor animation player slices.
Reuse the existing KpAnimationAsset runtime clock, semantic bundles, visual-frame adapters, KaTeX ownership rules, and graph samplers.
Add focused editor renderers, controls, browser checks, and closeout evidence.
disallowedWork: Do not create a second animation clock or duplicate semantic animation assets.
Do not add media encoders, live CAS or LSP integrations, curriculum generation, dynamic package loading, or a broad editor redesign.
Do not stage unrelated dirty worktree files.
goal: Mount the approved concrete family-backed animations as visible, playable, scrubbable, and rewindable editor cards on the shared KP runtime clock.
stopConditions: Stop if a visual cannot be derived honestly from the asset semantics without product judgment.
Stop if shared player integration requires a broad editor rewrite beyond the approved contract.
Stop if verification fails and the fix is not local to the active slice.
Stop when all approved slices are complete.
